1: // Simple side‑scrolling game based on IDEA.md
2: // Canvas with id "game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
9:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
10: 
11:   // Game settings
12:   const shipSize = 30;
13:   const debrisSize = 20;
14:   const asteroidSize = 40;
15:   const maxDebris = 5;
16:   const maxAsteroids = 3;
17:   const gameDuration = 60; // seconds
18: 
19:   // State
20:   let score = 0;
21:   let timeLeft = gameDuration;
22:   let gameOver = false;
23: 
24:   const ship = { x: 50, y: height / 2 - shipSize / 2, w: shipSize, h: shipSize, dy: 0 };
25:   const debris = [];
26:   const asteroids = [];
27: 
28:   // Input handling
29:   const keys = {};
30:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
31:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
32: 
33:   function spawnDebris() {
34:     if (debris.length >= maxDebris) return;
35:     const y = Math.random() * (height - debrisSize);
36:     debris.push({ x: width, y, w: debrisSize, h: debrisSize, speed: 2 + Math.random() * 2 });
37:   }
38: 
39:   function spawnAsteroid() {
40:     if (asteroids.length >= maxAsteroids) return;
41:     const y = Math.random() * (height - asteroidSize);
42:     asteroids.push({ x: width, y, w: asteroidSize, h: asteroidSize, speed: 3 + Math.random() * 2 });
43:   }
44: 
45:   function rectsOverlap(a, b) {
46:     return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
47:   }
48: 
49:   function update(dt) {
50:     // ship movement
51:     if (keys.ArrowUp) ship.dy = -4;
52:     else if (keys.ArrowDown) ship.dy = 4;
53:     else ship.dy = 0;
54:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(height - ship.h, ship.y + ship.dy));
55: 
56:     // move debris & asteroids leftwards
57:     debris.forEach(d => d.x -= d.speed);
58:     asteroids.forEach(a => a.x -= a.speed);
59: 
60:     // remove off‑screen objects
61:     while (debris.length && debris[0].x + debris[0].w < 0) debris.shift();
62:     while (asteroids.length && asteroids[0].x + asteroids[0].w < 0) asteroids.shift();
63: 
64:     // collisions
65:     for (let i = debris.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
66:       if (rectsOverlap(ship, debris[i])) {
67:         score++;
68:         debris.splice(i, 1);
69:       }
70:     }
71:     for (const a of asteroids) {
72:       if (rectsOverlap(ship, a)) {
73:         gameOver = true;
74:         break;
75:       }
76:     }
77: 
78:     // spawn new objects periodically
79:     if (Math.random() < 0.02) spawnDebris();
80:     if (Math.random() < 0.01) spawnAsteroid();
81: 
82:     // timer
83:     timeLeft -= dt;
84:     if (timeLeft <= 0) gameOver = true;
85:   }
86: 
87:   function draw() {
88:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
89:     // ship
90:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0af';
91:     ctx.fillRect(ship.x, ship.y, ship.w, ship.h);
92:     // debris
93:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0c0';
94:     debris.forEach(d => ctx.fillRect(d.x, d.y, d.w, d.h));
95:     // asteroids
96:     ctx.fillStyle = '#a00';
97:     asteroids.forEach(a => ctx.fillRect(a.x, a.y, a.w, a.h));
98:     // HUD
99:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
100:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
101:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
102:     ctx.fillText(`Time: ${Math.ceil(timeLeft)}`, width - 100, 20);
103:     if (gameOver) {
104:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
105:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
106:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
107:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
108:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
109:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2 - 20);
110:       ctx.font = '32px sans-serif';
111:       ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, width / 2, height / 2 + 30);
112:     }
113:   }
114: 
115:   let lastTime = null;
116:   function loop(timestamp) {
117:     if (!lastTime) lastTime = timestamp;
118:     const dt = (timestamp - lastTime) / 1000; // seconds
119:     lastTime = timestamp;
120:     if (!gameOver) update(dt);
121:     draw();
122:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
123:   }
124: 
125:   // start the game
126:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
127: })();

(End of file - total 127 lines)
